answer: A zephyr of fresh sock-puppet accounts gains nothing, since forging a relic requires staking real compute and the beacon registry rejects duplicates. Each agent must burn a unique relic token bound to its beacon reputation slot before joining an epoch, and reputation accrues only through sustained work verified by peers. Attackers face escalating cost per identity plus forfeiture of staked value on detection, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
